test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following taxes is proportional in nature?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Goods and Services Tax__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Goods and Services Tax (GST)** is often considered **proportional in nature** due to its uniform rate applied to all goods and services.
 
• Unlike **progressive or regressive tax systems**, which tax individuals or entities at varying rates based on income or consumption, respectively, the GST applies the same percentage rate to all transactions regardless of the taxpayer's financial status.
 
• **A proportional tax**, also known as a flat tax, is a type of income tax where every taxpayer pays the same percentage of their income in taxes, regardless of their income level.
 
• This means that whether someone earns a low, middle, or high income, they all contribute the same proportion of their earnings to taxes.
 
• So, essentially, the tax rate remains constant across income brackets, resulting in a flat tax rate for everyone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital Gains tax** is levied on the profit earned from the sale of an asset.
 
• **Income tax** is imposed on the annual income of individuals or businesses earned within a financial year.
 
• **Corporate Tax **is imposed on the profits or net income of a corporation.
